addition.item: Search: a search box over every cell, with the matches highlighted. Accents can be ignored, so "cafe" finds "café".
Sorting: visitors sort by the columns you allow, by value: numbers and ratings as numbers, dates as dates, yes / no and text in order. The table can start sorted by a column.
Filters: a dropdown with the values of a column; values separated by commas (such as tags) can be separate choices.
Pages: show a number of rows per page, with page links and "Showing 1–10 of 42".
Everything works in the browser without loading data; without JavaScript every row shows.

First release: tables with up to 24 columns. Each column has a heading, a type (text, number, date, image, icon, rating, yes / no, button or tags), alignment, width and the screen size from which it shows. Text can be shortened to a number of characters; numbers get decimals, separators and text before or after (e.g. RM); dates take one of 17 formats in the site language.
Every cell can have its own link. Images open in a lightbox, row numbers can be added, and the header row can stay in view while the table scrolls in a box.
On small screens the table scrolls sideways or shows each row as a card with the column names.
Rows can come from dynamic content such as articles. Headings and cells can be translated with a multilingual plugin that reads the "translate" flag.
